_comment: Which BizBox views and columns Dada PSA mirrors, read-only. As SQL01 built them on 29 Sep 2026 (MEASURED from its Reply in
docs/handoffs/HANDOFF-cloud-sql01-WS36-20260929-bizbox.md): schema psa in the BizBox database, four views, a login that can
read only those. The real map lives on the host (D:\psa\bizbox-map.json), not in the repo; this copy is the shape.
psaspine refuses any name that looks like a patient table or field.
There is no agreement kind: BizBox holds no supplier agreements (its contract tables are patient coverage). If a source is
"amount", "currency"}}} and, on the invoice, "agreement_ref". The Finance page shows the Agreements tab once rows exist.
An invoice here is BizBox's receiving report (its key is the receiving number); supplier_ref is the supplier's own invoice
number, which staff type and which repeats, so it is never the key. Status is BizBox's own word; paid is not knowable there.

Optional, 13 Oct 2026 (081): a "lookup" object reads BizBox's own code lists for the desk's dropdowns, e.g. {"lookup": {"view": "psa.vw_lookup", "columns": {"list": "ListName", "code": "Code", "label": "Label", "sort_no": "SortNo"}}}; list is one of po_status, rr_status, currency, unit, category. Not in this sample, so a desk without the view reads as before.

Optional, 13 Oct 2026 (083): "warehouse" (ext_ref, name, group_name, active) and "medicine" (ext_ref = the item code, generic, dosage, controlled, doh_ref, mims_ref, admin_group, remarks) read SQL01's psa.vw_warehouse and psa.vw_drug_item; see the 083 handoff for the columns.
